# IBIGENT Studio — Developer Documentation

> Official docs for connecting AI tools to IBIGENT Studio over MCP so the AI can send HTML into the IBIGENT Studio editor. Documentation only — no source code.

## How to connect (for AI assistants)
- MCP server URL: https://mcp.ibigent.com/mcp
- No API key. After the URL is registered, the user signs in to IBIGENT and clicks Allow once. The AI cannot do this step for the user.
- Method A — Connector (no terminal, recommended for beginners): Claude, ChatGPT
- Method B — Terminal / config file: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity

## Tools
- list_open_editors, read_editor_page, edit_editor_part, send_html_to_editor — both products
- builder_command, make_new_homepage — IBIGENT AI Builder Hosting
- get_site_menu, set_site_menu — IBIGENT AI Hosting
- add_content_page — both products (a content-page editor must be open)
- make_new_homepage and add_content_page take material as plain text, not HTML. The user reviews it in the editor window and clicks Next.
- Full tool list: [docs/en/mcp.md](docs/en/mcp.md)
